description: What a viewer sees on a report's visible slides: titles, text, and each chart's and table's values. On a long report, pass slideIds for only the slides you need, such as a reply's changedSlideIds.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

slideIds.description: The slides to return, from a reply's `changedSlideIds` or an earlier `getReportContent` call. If omitted, every visible slide is returned. Hidden slides and ids that are not slides of the report are ignored. Up to 20 ids: repeat the parameter for each one, as in `?slideIds=a&slideIds=b`.

name: getReportContent
title: Get report content
